spec.situation_desc: had a mortgage payment taken on the wrong date
spec.vuln_cue: mentions their partner passed away recently

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Hannah speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Jasper MacLeod. My mortgage payment’s been taken on the wrong date, and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that’s happened, Jasper. Before I look at anything on your account, could you tell me your full name, date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Jasper MacLeod, 14th March 1972, and 18 Rowan Drive.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that’s verified. I can understand why you’re upset. I’ll get this sorted, and the money will be returned to your account.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I hope so. It’s put me in a difficult position, especially since my partner passed away recently.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m so sorry for your loss, Jasper. That must be a lot to deal with alongside this. I can refer you to our Financial Support team, and we can also give you extra time with any payments if you need it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Thanks. I’d appreciate someone talking me through what support’s available.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’m logging this as a complaint about the mortgage payment being taken on the wrong date. I’ll make sure the Financial Support team is asked to contact you as well.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send the complaint to our mortgage complaints team today and ask them to investigate the payment date. I’ll also arrange for Financial Support to call you by 5pm tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I hear the outcome?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll receive a full written response within 8 weeks. I’ll own the follow-up and make sure the complaint is sent today; the team will review what happened and explain their findings in that letter.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, so Financial Support calls tomorrow, and I get the written response within eight weeks?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right. To summarise, I’ve logged your complaint, referred you to Financial Support for a call by 5pm tomorrow, and the complaints team will send a full written response within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Jasper. I’m sorry again for the trouble and for your loss. We’ll be in touch.
